description: This source file defines the ClientHelper class which provides utility methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and managing clients within the Fineract system. It includes functions to simulate various client lifecycle operations such as creation, activation, rejection, withdrawal, and closure, often involving JSON payload generation and REST API calls.

classes.name: ClientHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to manage client entities via REST API calls, including creation, updates, status changes, and data retrieval in the Fineract system.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client in the system with a specified request object.

methods.name: searchClients
methods.description: Performs client search based on text input, with options for pagination and sorting.

methods.name: addClientAsPerson
methods.description: Adds a client as a person with specified JSON payload.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates client information based on external ID with a JSON payload.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client by external ID.

methods.name: getClientAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves accounts associated with a client by external ID.

methods.name: getProposedTransferDate
methods.description: Fetches proposed transfer date for a client.

methods.name: getObligeeData
methods.description: Retrieves obligee details for a client.

methods.name: createClientPending
methods.description: Creates a client in pending state with a specified submitted date.

methods.name: createClientAsPerson
methods.description: Creates a non-pending client as a person.

methods.name: createClientAsEntity
methods.description: Creates a non-pending client as an entity/organization.

methods.name: performClientActions
methods.description: Performs actions on clients like activation, rejection, withdrawal using specific URLs and JSON payloads.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Fetches detailed info of a client by ID.

methods.name: revertClientChargeTransaction
methods.description: Reverts a specific charge transaction for a client by executing a POST request to the undo transaction endpoint. Deprecated for removal; intended to be replaced by fineract-client operations.

methods.name: getClientCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific charge for a client, such as amount outstanding. Deprecated for removal; to be replaced with fineract-client methods.

methods.name: getClientTransactions
methods.description: Checks if a client transaction has been reversed by executing a GET request. Deprecated for removal; scheduled for replacement.

methods.name: getAllClientTransactionsByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches all transactions associated with a client identified by external ID, using the Fineract client API.

methods.name: getClientTransactionByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transaction using external ID and transaction ID via the Fineract client API.

methods.name: getClientTransactionByTransactionExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a client transaction based on client ID and external transaction ID via the Fineract client API.

methods.name: undoClientTransactionByExternalId
methods.description: Undoes a client transaction specified by external ID and transaction ID using the client API.

methods.name: undoClientTransactionByTransactionExternalId
methods.description: Undoes a client transaction using client ID and external transaction ID via the client API.

methods.name: getClientEntityWorkbook
methods.description: Downloads a client entity template as an Excel workbook. Deprecated for removal, intended to be replaced by newer client library methods.

methods.name: getOutputTemplateLocation
methods.description: Fetches the location of an import output template from the server, given an import document ID.

methods.name: importClientEntityTemplate
methods.description: Uploads a client entity template file to the server for import purposes.

methods.name: getClientWithStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a list of clients filtered by status with pagination limit, via direct API call.

methods.name: defaultClientCreationRequest
methods.description: Constructs a default request object for creating a new client with randomized names and a UUID external ID.

methods.name: retrieveLockedAccounts
methods.description: Uses the Fineract client API to retrieve a list of locked loan accounts, paged.

methods.name: createClientIdentifer
methods.description: Generates a request object for creating a client identifier with random key and description, and specified document type.
